dependencies.name: Apple Mobile Device driver
dependencies.desc: Required. Provides the Windows USB service that lets the PC talk to iPhones/iPads. Install the free 'Apple Devices' app from the Microsoft Store (or iTunes). Opens in your browser/Store — run the installer, then come back.

dependencies.name: libimobiledevice tools
dependencies.desc: Required. The open-source command-line tools that read the device. One-click download: TM Phone fetches, checksum-verifies, and installs them into its own tools folder (portable — travels with the app).
